sentences.en: Our continuing work is motivated by the necessity of providing Image Guided therapy in order to provide highly conformal treatments.

sentences.en: This means that the program content and delivery remain congruent with the model of therapy.

sentences.en: Coombs ' positive anemia has not been reported in patients taking apomorphine in association with other therapy.

sentences.en: The recent loss of hormone replacement therapy from the therapeutic armamentarium has left a need for new ways to prevent bone loss.

sentences.en: The effect is then wrongly ascribed to the alternative therapy.
